desc: quickstart_pick_window in German menus on a 1920x1080 widescreen window (long words: squeezed to the window, nothing past it): the file menu's new files keep the original New Game card; {A} on file 1 opens the small window over the menu (the menu's own white window, black letters and hand): New Game, Start from the beginning and Start in Rogueport with a line each, Back.
